about: Round 40 pose proposals, baked by tools/r40_an/make_poses.py; keys per engine frame in the B3D's frame: position x, y, z and rotation w, x, y, z in the parent bone's space.

poses.label: Cast, one hand: palm forward
poses.use: single-target spells (Fireball, Smite, Word of Ruin, Cinderfall)

poses.label: Diagonal cut
poses.use: Mighty Blow (matches the diagonal slash trail)

poses.label: Bow: drawn and held
poses.use: Scout shots while the bow is drawn

poses.label: Guard: shield arm raised
poses.use: Hold Ground, a shield in the off hand
